These quantities cover mass, length, time, temperature, and energy aspects necessary for dimensional analysis to form a dimensionless group representing the keyhole depth.

variables.physical_definition: Material density, mass per unit volume of the material.
Temperature difference between melting temperature and ambient temperature.
Laser beam radius, characteristic length scale of the laser spot.
Thermal diffusivity, rate of thermal diffusion through the material.
Effective laser power, energy delivered per unit time by the laser.
Specific heat capacity coefficient, heat needed to raise the material temperature per unit mass and temperature increase.
Laser scan speed, velocity at which the laser moves over the material surface.

KB record pq_specific_heat_capacity (canonical: specific heat capacity; symbols c_p) has SI dimensions L^2 T^-2 Theta^-1 (vector [0,2,-2,0,-1,0,0]) matching the ledger definition.
